simple.meaning: רֵעַ (rêaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a crash (of thunder), noise (of war), shout (of joy).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רֵעַ (H7452) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 32:17, with occurrences in Exodus, Job, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רֵעַ (H7452) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in רֵעַ (H7452) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: רֵעַ (rêaʻ) / H7452 is traced through Exodus 32:17, Job 36:33, Micah 4:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
